note: Rule text is a simplified prototype mapping for demonstration purposes only. It is NOT a certified legal text of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and MUST be verified against the official Gazette notification before any production/legal use.

rules.title: Declaration of Product Name
rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared on the package.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - general declaration requirements (simplified for demo; verify exact rule number officially)

rules.title: Declaration of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
rules.requirement: Name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6 (simplified for demo; verify exact clause officially)

rules.title: Declaration of Complete Address
rules.requirement: A complete address (not merely a city/PIN) must accompany the manufacturer/packer/importer name.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (simplified for demo)

rules.title: Declaration of Net Quantity
rules.requirement: Net quantity must be declared in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, or count for numbers).
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6/Schedule (simplified for demo)

rules.title: Declaration of Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.requirement: MRP inclusive of all taxes must be declared, prefixed with an unambiguous currency indicator (e.g. ₹ or Rs.) and a numeric value greater than zero.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6 (simplified for demo)

rules.title: Declaration of Manufacturing/Packing/Import Date
rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import must be declared in a recognizable date format.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6 (simplified for demo)

rules.title: Declaration of Consumer Care Details
rules.requirement: A consumer care contact (phone number, email, or dedicated address/helpline) must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6 (simplified for demo)

rules.title: Declaration of Country of Origin (where applicable)
rules.requirement: For imported packages, the country of origin/manufacture/assembly must be declared.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (simplified for demo)
